svg.title: Phase 3, Post: a cold re-read, proof, then threads
svg.desc: Five findings travel as lines through three stations to the pull request. A cheap filter re-reads the cited code cold and demotes a finding whose evidence it cannot support into the round summary, never dropping one. Every suggestion fence is applied in a scratch worktree and the project's check runs; three pass and post as suggestions, one fails and is withdrawn while its finding stays. post-review then opens one inline thread per finding and one summary comment, writing the thread ids to the records. Open findings go on to the fix loop; a fork that refuses maintainer edits stops after posting in review-only mode.
svg.text: Proof before posting. A false positive costs a round, a thread, and the author’s trust.
the orchestrating session sees one line per script

text.tspan: 4 posted inline, 1 in the summary, round 1

svg.text: does the code show exactly this?
a blocker or major is demoted

g.text: the findings stand; the run stops here

svg.text: stops or parks; the number is the exit code
